zh: 「插件」改名为「工具」，首页改成双列卡片，每个工具都有图标和一句话说明。
翻译合成一个页面：上方显示译文，下方是输入栏。按住麦克风说话，松开即翻译；点相机可拍照或从相册选图。
打车的起点和终点可以直接搜索地点名称，先选城市再搜；没有结果时会提示换个叫法或核对城市。
新增「附近」：查看身边的美食、景点、咖啡和购物，可打车前往、用高德地图导航或出示中文地址。地铁指南改为先选城市。
en: Plugins is now called Tools, with a two-column card for each tool showing an icon and one line about it.
Translation is one page: the translation on top and an input bar below. Hold the microphone to talk and release to translate; tap the camera to take a photo or choose one.
Search for taxi pickup and destination places by name after choosing a city. If nothing is found, you get a tip to try another name or check the city.
New Nearby tool: find food, sights, coffee and shopping around you, then take a taxi, get directions in AMap or show the address in Chinese. The Metro Guide now starts by choosing a city.

zh: 构建 54 接续构建 53。翻译去掉了文字、语音、拍照三种模式切换。附近的地图使用苹果地图，中国大陆底图来自高德。
en: Build 54 follows build 53. Translation no longer switches between text, voice and photo modes. The Nearby map uses Apple Maps, whose mainland China map data comes from AMap.

zh: 用默认字号测中英界面：工具首页卡片，以及翻译页的打字、按住说话、拍照和从相册选图。
打车：在北京、上海、成都各搜 3 个常见地点（如天安门、外滩、宽窄巷子），确认能生成滴滴链接。只走到滴滴确认页，请勿下单。
附近：允许定位后切换分类、范围和排序，打开一个地点试打车、导航和出示地址。地铁指南先选城市再看步骤。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录及发生时间。
en: At the default text size, check both languages: the Tools cards, and typing, holding to talk, taking a photo and choosing a photo in Translation.
Taxi: search 3 common places each in Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu (for example Tiananmen, the Bund, Kuanzhai Alley) and check that a DiDi link opens. Stop at vehicle confirmation without ordering.
Nearby: allow location, switch categories, distance and order, then open a place and try taxi, directions and the Chinese address. In the Metro Guide, choose a city first.
Share a screenshot, the copied issue record and the time it happened in the internal testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 可缩放的交互式地铁图还在等待授权，本版只有城市选择、乘车步骤和官方线路图链接。
酒店、千问朗读、天气、航班、上网卡、玩乐暂未开放。本地协助暂不发送求助消息。附近暂不支持问 Lio 和加进行程。
en: The zoomable metro map is waiting for approval. This build has city choice, riding steps and links to official maps.
Hotels, Qwen voice playback, Weather, Flights, eSIM and Activities are unavailable. Local Support does not send help requests. Nearby cannot yet ask Lio or add a place to a trip.

zh: 打车地点搜索和附近需要联网，供已开通的内测账号使用。地点来自滴滴和高德。
滴滴决定实际价格。打车只在滴滴继续。
en: Taxi place search and Nearby require internet access and an enabled tester account. Places come from DiDi and AMap.
DiDi sets the final price and handles the ride.

zh: 本地协助可离线查看紧急号码和使领馆目录，也可出示中文求助卡。聊天页可打开 SOS，求助草稿只保存在本机。
常用语卡片可放大、朗读；地铁指南提供北京、上海和成都的乘车步骤及官方线路图。
支付开通指南介绍支付宝和微信支付的境外卡绑定步骤及常见问题。汇率换算新增欧洲央行参考汇率，含人民币，并显示汇率日期。
打车可从行程选地点、查看估价或在滴滴打开。可把目的地的中文地址直接给司机看。
en: Use Local Support offline to view emergency numbers, find embassies and consulates, or show a help card in Chinese. Open SOS from Chat. Help drafts stay on this device.
Phrase cards show and read common phrases. The Metro Guide covers Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu, with links to official maps.

The Payment Setup Guide explains how to link an international card in Alipay or Weixin Pay and what to check when setup fails. Currency Converter shows the ECB reference rates and their date, including Chinese yuan.
Use a trip stop to get a taxi estimate, open DiDi, or show the destination address in Chinese.

zh: 构建 53 接续构建 51。翻译的文字、语音、图片均使用在线千问。图片译文可按照片中的文字位置显示，也可逐行对照。
en: Build 53 follows build 51. Text, voice and photo translation use Qwen online. See translated text in place on the photo, or switch to a line-by-line view.

zh: 用默认字号测中英界面，打开旧对话、切后台再恢复，核对草稿；再测三种翻译和打车预填。图片翻译可切换译图、照片和逐行对照。在汇率换算里试一次人民币换算，核对来源日期。语音翻译可加测一段约一秒的中文录音。
开飞行模式查看本地协助、使馆、中文卡和草稿。请勿拨打任何号码。滴滴只走到确认页，请勿下单。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录及发生时间。
en: At the default text size, check both languages. Reopen an earlier chat, return from the background, and confirm the draft. Try all three translation modes and taxi prefill. For photos, switch between the translated photo, the photo itself and the line-by-line view. Convert a yuan amount and check the rate date. Include a Chinese voice recording around one second long.
In airplane mode, check Local Support, embassies, the Chinese cards and drafts. Do not place any calls. In DiDi, stop at vehicle confirmation without ordering.
Share a screenshot, the copied issue record and the time it happened in the internal testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 酒店、千问朗读、附近、天气、航班、上网卡、玩乐暂未开放。
本地协助暂不发送求助消息，也不会从对话自动触发。查看当前位置的中文地址和医疗卡尚未开放。
en: Hotels, Qwen voice playback, Nearby, Weather, Flights, eSIM and Activities are unavailable in this build.
Local Support does not send help requests or open automatically from chat. The Chinese address lookup and medical card are unavailable.

zh: 翻译和打车需要联网，供已开通的内测账号使用。滴滴决定实际价格。打车只在滴滴继续。
修复很短的中文语音翻译偶尔失败。
修复追问行程天数时偶尔丢失已提供日期。
en: Translation and taxi estimates require internet access and an enabled tester account. DiDi sets the final price and handles the ride.
Fixed occasional failures when translating very short Chinese recordings.
Fixed an issue where Lio could lose dates you had already shared when asking how many days you would travel.
